title: Stop a ramified coefficient search at a gauge-complete modular seed
status_authority: Completed working derivation supplied with original proof; no substantive completed review of this new result is claimed.
reported_status: Completed working derivation supplied with original proof; no substantive completed review of this new result is claimed.
scientific_scope_status: The acquired working proof gives a general gauge-complete tangent criterion: if exact identity-near solution-preserving transformations span the whole modular Jacobian kernel, an ordinary Hensel obstruction cannot be repaired by ANY finite ramification with that integral reduction. At the supplied characteristic2rank47seed, the whole139-dimensional tangent kernel is symmetry-generated and the old mod4defect has an exact separating functional. Independent rank-one term tensors also close individual coefficient-pole escapes at the same projective reduction.
